result.answer: SB-AX17-2026-09 requires a temporary hepatic monitoring enhancement consisting of baseline hepatic laboratory values with repeat testing between Day 14 and Day 21 [E1]. It also specifies that ALT/AST >3x ULN requires medical review, Bilirubin >2x ULN requires urgent review, and a mild isolated change below trigger requires a repeat test [E2]. Furthermore, it does not change the approved German renal starting dose of 25 mg once daily for moderate renal impairment [E1].
